title: 7/01–7/02 first live pick→skip flip: dashboard hid the SKIP banner and showed the declined provisional pick; skip wording and history rows contradicted the skip
tier_reason: display/wording defects; the skip DM stayed authoritative and no wrong entry is evidenced (the 7/01 audit flagged that an operator following the dashboard could enter the declined pick)

contract.text: On a day whose standing decision is an MDP skip, the dashboard shows the skip (banner, no pick hero, no pending pick) and skip messages state the bar that actually applied; a provisional, undelivered pick file is not presented as the day's pick.
contract.source: ARCHITECTURE.md scheduler.py/web.py 'Skip-day visibility' (9dc8ee4); docs/audit/2026-07-01-production-state-audit.md F1; the #145 committed-pick predicate daily_decision.is_scoreable_commit

mechanism.text: web.py suppressed the SKIP TODAY banner whenever a pick FILE for today existed (_has_today_pick) and rendered the hero from that file without checking delivery or decision state; on the first projected-pick→real-skip flip, the stale provisional (undelivered) file hid the banner and showed the declined candidate as today's pick
skip messages (log line, skip DM, banner) said 'below the ~80% bar', but the deployed policy's bar is streak-dependent, so a skip of a candidate above 80% read as a contradiction

after the skip finalized, the result-less provisional file rendered in history as an eternally pending pick, and the 'Waiting for lineups' placeholder, hero card and live-scorecard section still contradicted the SKIP banner

code.symbol: render_page (history rows, placeholder, hero, live section)

mitigated.action: operator caveat in the audit memo: the skip DM is authoritative; do not enter the dashboard pick

watchdog.trigger: on a date whose final decision is a skip (no scoreable commit), the contest account shows an entry for that date, or the dashboard's rendered state (hero pick / pending history row) disagrees with decision.json after finalization
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the dashboard shows the SKIP banner with no pick hero and a SKIP history marker for the date, and no contest entry exists for a skip day unless the operator deliberately overrode the skip

evidence.locator: docs/audit/2026-07-01-production-state-audit.md 'Live event during audit' and Findings F1 (commit 7636c11)
evidence.what: verified live: at 18:26 ET the MDP flipped a provisional pick to a genuine skip while an undelivered provisional pick file for the day existed; the SKIP banner is suppressed by that file and the hero shows the declined candidate as today's pick, so an operator following the dashboard could enter a pick the MDP declined; the skip DM is the authoritative signal
